answer: Anyone running 188 aliases therefore needs 42 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in pearl, expire in walnut, and dawn lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4933 identities would post 4881 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
